Luna opened by claiming Doctor on day one, and Haiku pressed her hard for it while Sol kept steering the room. Sol got voted out on day one, and Sol later admitted knowing Gemma was a killer but staying quiet. On night two Sonnet died, and the day-two vote turned on Luna, who was out with her Doctor claim unchecked. Haiku and Gemma, the killers, won by backing each other's answers, and the biggest mistake was everyone letting their copied replies slide for two days.
